meta.evidence_status: SIMULATION (hand-pen model H1 with the Rev H handle; synthetic handwriting and tremor; nothing measured)
meta.units: mm, rad; page frame x along the line, y up the page; axis = unit vector of the pen axis

headline.label: SIM (model H1, Rev H-B, test seeds 200-203; glyph test seeds 210-213 for distortion)

scenarios.title: A shake of 1 mm, 10 times a second

off.label: New pen, nose held still
off.description: Rev H pen (22 mm handle), nose held centred: the ink carries the hand tremor minus what the skid friction absorbs.

best.label: New pen, if it knew the shake exactly
best.description: Active nose (architecture B) with perfect knowledge of the tremor: the ceiling of the mechanism (+/-3 mm travel).

today.label: New pen, today's tracker
today.description: Active nose driven by the accelerometer tracker (Rev H setting): what a real pen could do (causal).

module.label: New pen, today's tracker + rear module
module.description: Active nose plus the rear-cap reaction mass, both causal (the evaluated rear-cap module; not fitted in the standard Rev H).
